completions.create.description: Creates a model response for the given chat conversation.

responses.create.description: Creates a model response in the OpenAI Responses API format. The API is stateless, so the full conversation history must be sent on each request.

user.get_balance.description: Retrieves the current user account balance information.

files.upload.description: Uploads an image file (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP, max 64 MiB) which can later be referenced by its file_id. Form fields: file, purpose (user_data) and optionally expires_after[anchor] (created_at) and expires_after[seconds] (3600-2592000).

files.list.description: Returns a list of files that belong to the user, with cursor-based pagination.

files.retrieve.description: Returns information about a specific file.

Completion_Choice.description: A choice generated by the chat completion model.

index.description: The index of the choice in the list of choices.

message.description: A chat completion message generated by the model.

finish_reason.description: The reason the model stopped generating tokens: stop, length, content_filter, tool_calls, insufficient_system_resource or aborted.

logprobs.description: Log probability information for the choice.

Completion_Choice_Logprobs.description: Log probability information for the choice.

content.description: A list of message content tokens with log probability information.

reasoning_content.description: A list of reasoning content tokens with log probability information.

Completion_Token_Logprob.description: Log probability information for a token.

logprob.description: The log probability of this token.

bytes.description: A list of integers representing the UTF-8 bytes representation of the token.

top_logprobs.description: List of the most likely tokens and their log probability at this token position.

logprob.description: The log probability of this token.

bytes.description: A list of integers representing the UTF-8 bytes representation of the token.

Completion_Message.description: Base message struct for conversation context.

role.description: The role of the author of this message.

content.description: The contents of the assistant message.

name.description: An optional name for the participant.

prefix.description: (Beta) Set to true to force the model to start its answer with the content of this assistant message. Requires the beta base URL.

reasoning_content.description: The reasoning contents of the assistant message (Chain-of-Thought) produced during thinking mode.

tool_calls.description: The tool calls generated by the model, such as function calls.

content.description: The contents of the system message.

name.description: An optional name for the participant.

content.description: The contents of the tool message as a list of content parts (text, image or file).

tool_call_id.description: Tool call that this message is responding to.

content.description: The contents of the user message as a list of content parts (text, image or file).

name.description: An optional name for the participant.

Completion_Tool_Call.description: A tool call generated by the model.

id.description: The ID of the tool call.

type.description: The type of the tool. Currently, only 'function' is supported.

function.description: The function that the model called.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

arguments.description: The arguments to call the function with, as generated by the model in JSON format.

type.description: The type of the tool. Always 'function'.

description.description: A description of what the function does.

parameters.description: The parameters the function accepts, described as a JSON Schema object.

strict.description: (Beta) If true, the API uses strict mode so tool calls always comply with the JSON schema of the function.

Completion_Response_Format.description: An object specifying the format that the model must output.

include_usage.description: If set, an additional chunk with token usage details will be sent right before the [DONE] stream message.

model.description: ID of the model to use (e.g., deepseek-flash, deepseek-v4-pro).

messages.description: A list of messages comprising the conversation so far.

thinking.description: Controls the switch between thinking and non-thinking mode.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the chat completion.

logprobs.description: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not.

response_format.description: An object specifying the format that the model must output.

stop.description: Up to 16 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens.

stream.description: If set, partial message deltas will be sent as server-sent events.

tools.description: A list of tools the model may call.

tool_choice.description: Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model. Either the string none, auto or required, or a Completion_Tool_Choice object.

top_logprobs.description: An integer between 0 and 20 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position.

user_id.description: A custom end-user identifier ([a-zA-Z0-9-_], max 512 chars), used for content safety review, KVCache isolation and scheduling isolation.

Completion_Usage.description: Usage statistics for the completion request.

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the generated completion.

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt.

prompt_cache_hit_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt that hit the context cache.

prompt_cache_miss_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt that missed the context cache.

total_tokens.description: Total number of tokens used in the request (prompt + completion).

prompt_tokens_details.description: Breakdown of tokens used in the prompt.

completion_tokens_details.description: Breakdown of tokens used in the completion.

id.description: A unique identifier for the chat completion.

object.description: The object type, which is always 'chat.completion'.

created.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the chat completion was created.

model.description: The model used for the chat completion.

choices.description: A list of chat completion choices.

system_fingerprint.description: This fingerprint represents the backend configuration that the model runs with.

usage.description: Usage statistics for the completion request.

model.description: ID of the model to use (e.g. deepseek-flash, deepseek-v4-pro).

prompt.description: The prompt to generate completions for.

suffix.description: The suffix that comes after a completion of inserted text.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate.

echo.description: Echo back the prompt in addition to the completion.

stop.description: Up to 16 sequences where the API will stop generating tokens.

stream.description: Whether to stream back partial progress via SSE.

logprobs.description: Include the log probabilities on the most likely output tokens (max 20).

finish_reason.description: Reason the model stopped generating tokens.

id.description: A unique identifier for the completion.

name.description: The display name of the model.

context_window.description: The total token capacity of the context window, counting both input and output tokens.

max_output_tokens.description: The maximum number of output tokens allowed in a single response.

input_modalities.description: The input types the model accepts (text, image).

output_modalities.description: The media types the model can generate.

effort.description: The effort levels available when thinking mode is enabled.

api_capabilities.description: Model behavior declared per API protocol.

User_Balance_Response.description: Response structure for user balance query.

is_available.description: Whether the user balance is available.

balance_infos.description: List of balance details per currency.

Completion_Content_Part.description: A content part of a user or tool message.

url.description: Either an http(s) URL of the image or a base64-encoded data URL (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP).

detail.description: Controls how the image is processed: low, high, original or auto.

file_id.description: The ID of a file uploaded via the Files API. Mutually exclusive with file_data.

file_data.description: A base64-encoded data URL of the image. Mutually exclusive with file_id.

filename.description: An optional filename. Only valid together with file_data.

Completion_Tool_Choice.description: Forces the model to call a specific function.

type.description: The type of the tool. Always 'function'.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

Completion_Thinking.description: Controls the switch between thinking and non-thinking mode.

reasoning_effort.description: The thinking effort: none, low, high or max. 'none' disables thinking mode.

Completion_Usage_Prompt_Details.description: Breakdown of tokens used in the prompt.

cached_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt that hit the context cache.

Completion_Usage_Completion_Details.description: Breakdown of tokens used in the completion.

reasoning_tokens.description: Tokens generated by the model for reasoning.

Fim_Completion_Logprobs.description: Log probability information for a FIM completion choice.

text_offset.description: Character offsets of the tokens in the text.

token_logprobs.description: The log probability of each token.

top_logprobs.description: The most likely tokens and their log probability at each position.

Model_Effort.description: The effort levels available when thinking mode is enabled.

supported_levels.description: The effort levels the model supports when thinking mode is enabled.

default_level.description: The effort level used when the request does not specify one.

Model_Api_Capabilities.description: Model behavior declared per API protocol.

anthropic_messages.description: Capabilities that apply when the model is used through the Anthropic Messages API.

Model_Api_Capabilities_Anthropic.description: Capabilities for the Anthropic Messages API.

system_prompt_update.description: How the model picks up an updated system prompt: leading-only or in-history.

id.description: The file identifier, of the form file-api-...

object.description: The object type, which is always 'file'.

bytes.description: The size of the file in bytes.

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the file was created.

purpose.description: The intended purpose of the file, always 'user_data'.

expires_at.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the file expires. Only present when an expiration was set at upload time.

object.description: The object type, which is always 'list'.

first_id.description: The ID of the first file in the list.

last_id.description: The ID of the last file in the list.

has_more.description: Whether there are more files beyond this page.

id.description: The ID of the deleted file.

object.description: The object type, which is always 'file'.

deleted.description: Whether the file was successfully deleted.

Response_Request.description: Request payload for the Responses API.

model.description: ID of the model to use (e.g., deepseek-flash, deepseek-v4-pro).

input.description: A list of input items. At least one of input and instructions is required.

instructions.description: A system-level instruction, inserted as the first system message of the model context.

max_output_tokens.description: An upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated, including visible output and reasoning tokens.

stream.description: If set, the response is streamed as semantic server-sent events.

tools.description: A list of tools the model may call.

tool_choice.description: Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model. Either the string none, auto or required, or a Response_Tool_Choice object.

top_logprobs.description: An integer between 0 and 20 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position.

user.description: A custom end-user identifier ([a-zA-Z0-9-_], max 512 chars).

Response_Input.description: An input item for the Responses API.

role.description: The role of the message author: user, assistant, system or developer.

content.description: A list of input_text, output_text or input_image content parts.

call_id.description: The ID pairing a function call with its output.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

arguments.description: The arguments to call the function with, in JSON format.

Response_Input_FunctionCallOutput.description: A function call output input item.

call_id.description: The ID pairing a function call with its output.

output.description: The output of the tool call, either a plain string or a list of input_text / input_image content parts.

content.description: A list of reasoning_text content parts.

Response_Content_Part.description: A content part of a Responses API input item.

image_url.description: An http(s) URL of the image or a base64-encoded data URL. Mutually exclusive with file_id.

detail.description: Controls how the image is processed: low, high, original or auto.

file_id.description: The ID of an image file uploaded via the Files API. Mutually exclusive with image_url.

effort.description: The thinking effort: none, low, high or max. 'none' disables thinking mode.

type.description: One of text (default), json_object or json_schema.

name.description: The name of the schema. Required when type is json_schema.

schema.description: The JSON Schema that the output must conform to. Required when type is json_schema.

Response_Tool.description: A tool the model may call.

type.description: The type of the tool. Always 'function'.

description.description: A description of what the function does.

parameters.description: The parameters the function accepts, described as a JSON Schema object.

Response_Tool_Choice.description: Forces the model to call a specific function.

type.description: The type of the tool. Always 'function'.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

Response_Response.description: A model response of the Responses API.

id.description: A unique identifier for the response.

object.description: The object type, which is always 'response'.

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the response was created.

status.description: The status of the response: in_progress, completed, incomplete or failed.

error.description: The error object when the response failed.

incomplete_details.description: The details about why the response is incomplete.

model.description: The model used for the response.

output.description: The list of output items generated by the model.

usage.description: Token usage statistics for the response.

Response_Error.description: The error object of a failed response.

Response_Incomplete_Details.description: The details about why the response is incomplete.

Response_Output.description: An output item generated by the model.

type.description: The type of the output item: message, reasoning or function_call.

id.description: The unique ID of the output item.

status.description: The status of the output item: in_progress, completed or incomplete.

content.description: For message items a list of output_text parts, for reasoning items a list of reasoning_text parts.

call_id.description: For function_call items. An identifier used when passing the function output back to the API.

name.description: For function_call items. The name of the function to call.

arguments.description: For function_call items. The arguments to call the function with, in JSON format.

Response_Output_Content.description: A content part of an output item.

Response_Usage.description: Token usage statistics for the response.

total_tokens.description: Total number of tokens used in the request (input + output).

cached_tokens.description: Number of input tokens that hit the context cache.

reasoning_tokens.description: Number of reasoning tokens generated by the model.
